description: Backtest a signal against your prices: rank, long and short quantiles, rebalance, trading only on what was known lag_days earlier, costs on actual trades. Pass ledger to judge the best of a search against all of it. A backtest measures one path of history under these costs; it does not establish that the signal will keep working.

cost_bps.description: Cost per unit traded, in basis points. Default 10.

label.description: The variant's name in the ledger. Default: the settings.

lag_days.description: Trading days between a signal becoming known and trading on it. Default 1, the minimum.

ledger.description: Record this run in a search ledger (created if new) and judge it against every run recorded there.

min_names.description: Skip a rebalance with fewer ranked names. Default 5.

prices_file.description: CSV: a date column (YYYY-MM-DD) and one column of closing prices per ticker.

quantile.description: Fraction of ranked names in each leg. Default 0.2.

rebalance.description: Default monthly; or every N trading days.

side.description: Default long_short: long the top quantile, short the bottom.

signal_file.description: CSV in the same shape; each row dated when its values became known (pit_factor writes this).

name: backtest_signal
title: Backtest a signal without lookahead
